name: Montclair Place
summary: Familiar department stores & other retailers line this modern 2-story mall with a food court.
description: Montclair Place is a premier shopping destination in Southern California's Inland Empire, offering an extensive selection of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment experiences including movies. With convenient hours, pet-friendly policies, and comprehensive guest services, the mall provides a VIP shopping experience where customers can follow their favorite stores and access exclusive deals and savings.
demographics: Montclair Place serves the diverse communities of the Inland Empire, drawing primarily from middle-income families and young professionals in the San Bernardino and eastern Los Angeles County areas. The trade area encompasses a growing, ethnically diverse population with household incomes ranging from moderate to upper-middle class, including significant Hispanic and Asian-American demographics. Shoppers at Montclair Place typically seek value-oriented to mid-tier retail options, with visitation patterns showing strong weekend family traffic and a preference for a mix of national chain retailers, dining, and entertainment options. The center serves as a regional hub for the surrounding suburban communities of Montclair, Ontario, Upland, and Pomona.
